name: mathterm
description: An Electron terminal with math-aware rich rendering, LaTeX/Markdown display, inline images, prompt navigation, and exportable math views.
author: Rixin Li

scripts.test: node test/backendLifecycle.test.js && node test/outputTransport.test.js && node test/outputCoalescer.test.js && node test/headlessWriteBatcher.test.js && node test/headlessTerminalState.test.js && node test/headlessTerminalBudget.test.js && node test/runtimeIds.test.js && node test/shellShim.test.js && node test/shellProfiles.test.js && node test/wslVtProxy.test.js && node test/terminalMetadata.test.js && node test/spawnCwd.test.js && node test/macInputBridge.test.js && node test/clipboardPaste.test.js && node test/markdownMath.test.js && node test/ptyManager.test.js && node test/cliOptions.test.js && node test/windowBounds.test.js && node test/layoutTree.test.js && node test/bufferText.test.js && node test/promptTrack.test.js && node test/ansi.test.js && node test/latex.test.js && node test/latexMacros.test.js && node test/richVirtual.test.js && node test/richDisplayMath.test.js && node test/richDisplayMathWrap.test.js && node test/richSnapshot.test.js && node test/mathSearch.test.js && node test/shiftSelection.test.js && node test/sessionFormat.test.js && node test/session.test.js
